description: Utility object for matrix operations and numerical computations in Spark MLlib, including functions for unpacking upper triangular matrices, indexing, computing log(1+exp(x)), and softmax operations.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: Object providing utility functions for matrix and numerical operations in Spark MLlib.

methods.name: unpackUpperTriangular
methods.description: Converts a packed upper triangular matrix into a full symmetric matrix in column major order.

methods.name: indexUpperTriangular
methods.description: Calculates the index in a packed array for the (i,j) element of an upper triangular matrix.

methods.name: log1pExp
methods.description: Computes log(1 + exp(x)) with numerical stability considerations.

methods.name: softmax
methods.description: Performs in-place softmax transformation on an array.

methods.name: softmax
methods.description: Performs softmax transformation with specified input/output parameters.
